text:
Type: white wall shelf with metal brackets
Use: displaying books, plants and decor; living room, home office, bedroom, hallway
Style: minimalist, modern, Scandinavian
Materials: white painted particleboard shelf, brushed aluminium brackets
Colors: white, silver grey
Shape: long thin flat board resting on two L-shaped brackets that wrap its ends, square profile, clean straight edges, slim and light
Feel: clean, airy, tidy
Goes with: white or pale grey walls, chrome or steel accents, light wood; minimalist, modern or Scandinavian rooms

product.name: EKBY JRPEN,EKBY BJRNUM
product.description: As the bracket covers the edge of the shelf; you can cut the shelf without the cut edge showing.
